description:
## Scope
Migrate reasoning/react/{config,strategy,runner,request_transformer}.ex and output.ex plus relevant state/token paths. Replace all direct generation, stream processing and StreamResponse usage reads with Backend/Stream operations. Remove ReqLLM generation-key/provider-option discovery from Config and Strategy. Normalize options against the effective model AFTER transformer overrides; backend remains fixed per run.
Extract OpenAI/OpenAICodex detection, WebSocket creation/reuse, provider module selection, openai_websocket_session injection, previous_response_id provider-option injection and close operations from Runner into ReqLLM adapter. Runtime owns only opaque session lifetime and generic continuation bookkeeping. Bind continuation to backend/model identity and invalidate incompatible model transitions. Preserve trace/progress/usage/tool-loop/classification behavior and scripted testing.
Output repair must carry exact backend Ref, effective model, options and appropriate session context including transformer changes. Keep parsing/validation/repair limits/policy in Jido; execute repair via selected backend.generate_object. Missing object support returns an explicit error, never remote fallback.
Update checkpoint compatibility with backend and stable model/deployment identity. Do not serialize credentials, handles, PIDs, refs or functions. Recognize old compatible ReqLLM tokens/fingerprints and response-ID state, reject legacy tokens under custom backends, and emit explicit backend identity for new tokens. Recreate live resources after resume.

## Acceptance criteria
- Full standalone and agent ReAct custom-backend tool loop and repair work without ReqLLM execution/model lookup.
- Stream cancellation includes blocked consumption, early halt, callback failure, owner death and repeated close.
- WebSocket reuse/default continuation still pass characterization tests.
- Model overrides revalidate backend options and cannot reuse incompatible continuation.
- Old token fixtures resume with compatible ReqLLM; backend/deployment mismatches reject deterministically.
- No provider-specific executable logic remains in Runner.

## Suggested commit
refactor(react): isolate backend sessions streams and repair calls

comments.text: Committed aaaa213c. ReAct standalone and agent custom backend stream, tool loop, model override and repair work; no direct ReqLLM execution/model lookup outside adapter remains. Backend session handles and provider-specific WebSocket/previous_response_id logic live in ReqLLM adapter; runner uses opaque session and portable Stream, with per-effective-model continuation identity persisted in checkpoint state. New tokens encode backend deployment identity with credential/live-handle scrubbing; legacy ReqLLM fixtures remain compatible and custom backends reject legacy tokens. Added tests for same/different model continuation, agent tool loop and repair, stream blocked cancellation, credential rotation and unsupported object error. Full mix test: 31 doctests, 2518 tests, zero failures (1 excluded); compile warnings-as-errors, focused format check and git diff --check pass. Pre-existing AGENTS.md and .serena/ changes untouched.

title: Isolate ReAct backend sessions, streams, continuation and repair
